# apple_beta_group (Resource)

Creates a TestFlight beta group. Internal groups are for App Store Connect users; external groups are for anyone, invited by email or a public link. An app needs an internal group before it can have an external one. Add builds to a group with the `apple_add_build_to_beta_groups` action, and testers with `apple_beta_group_tester`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

resource "apple_beta_group" "team" {
  app_id                   = data.apple_app.example.id
  name                     = "Team"
  internal                 = true
  has_access_to_all_builds = true
}

resource "apple_beta_group" "public" {
  app_id                    = data.apple_app.example.id
  name                      = "Public Beta"
  public_link_enabled       = true
  public_link_limit_enabled = true
  public_link_limit         = 1000

  # An app needs an internal group before it can have an external one.
  depends_on = [apple_beta_group.team]
}

output "public_link" {
  value = apple_beta_group.public.public_link
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app, e.g. `data.apple_app.example.id`.
- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Optional

- `feedback_enabled` (Boolean) Whether testers can send feedback through TestFlight.
- `has_access_to_all_builds` (Boolean) Internal groups only: whether testers get every build automatically. Changing it creates a new group.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the group is for internal testers (App Store Connect users). Defaults to `false`. Changing it creates a new group.
- `ios_builds_available_for_apple_silicon_mac` (Boolean) Whether iOS builds are available to testers on Apple silicon Macs.
- `ios_builds_available_for_apple_vision` (Boolean) Whether iOS builds are available to testers on Apple Vision Pro.
- `public_link_enabled` (Boolean) External groups only: whether testers can join with a public link.
- `public_link_limit` (Number) External groups only: the most testers who can join with the public link (1-10,000).
- `public_link_limit_enabled` (Boolean) External groups only: whether `public_link_limit` caps the testers who join with the public link.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the group was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group.
- `public_link` (String) The public link testers join with, when enabled.
- `public_link_id` (String) ID of the public link, when enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_group.public
  identity = {
    id = "9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_group.public 9b3c7d1e-0f2a-4b5c-8d6e-7f8091a2b3c4
```
